name: Why is professional water damage restoration necessary, even for small leaks?

mainEntity.name: Why is professional water damage restoration necessary, even for small leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even small leaks can lead to significant problems if not addressed professionally. Hidden moisture can penetrate porous materials like drywall and subflooring, creating ideal conditions for mold growth, which can start within 24-48 hours. Professionals use specialized equipment to detect hidden moisture, thoroughly dry affected areas, and prevent secondary damage that homeowners might overlook, ensuring a complete and safe restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals prevent hidden moisture and mold growth from even small leaks using specialized equipment. This ensures complete and safe restoration.
